olivia: Heads-up — we started a canary to enforce server-preferred cipher order on the regional proxies. Canary in EU looked fine, APAC saw a spike in TLS session-resume failures. Rolling back the APAC proxy change for now. Any obvious suspects? :thinking:

max: Oof. Did you change cipher preference only, or also removed any cipher suites?

olivia: Just switched to server-preferred and adjusted the order (moved ECDHE+CHACHA to top, AES-GCM after). No removals.

kevin: Can you share a small sample of the TLS logs from the APAC proxy? Might be session ticket decrypts.

olivia: Pasted a snippet from the proxy error log:```
2026-03-22T10:14:03Z WARN tls-handshake: session_resumption_failed client_ip=10.12.5.4 reason="session ticket decrypt failed: kms:AccessDenied" ticket_id=ab12ef
2026-03-22T10:14:03Z DEBUG keystore: decrypt_request key=proxy-session-ticket role=proxy-keystore-reader status=403
```

kevin: There it is. KMS AccessDenied on decrypt. Did we roll out that RBAC tighten last night?

max: Yes — I approved a policy prune for the keystore service accounts in APAC (reduce scope to env=prod only). Could be too strict for the proxy canary SA which still uses the older role binding.

sarah: If KMS returns AccessDenied, proxy falls back to full handshake which can expose higher latency and more failures if clients are doing mixed resumption. We need audit logs from KMS + keystore to confirm. @auditor-bot can you fetch the last 1h decrypt denies for key=proxy-session-ticket in apac region?

auditor-bot: query accepted. returning summarized results...

auditor-bot: ```
2026-03-22 10:13:58 KMS_DECRYPT_DENY key=proxy-session-ticket principal=svc-proxy-canary-apac action=Decrypt reason=PrincipalNotInRole
2026-03-22 10:14:01 KMS_DECRYPT_DENY key=proxy-session-ticket principal=svc-proxy-canary-apac action=Decrypt reason=PrincipalNotInRole
```

kevin: Confirms RBAC. Two-parter to fix: 1) Restore minimal decrypt permission for svc-proxy-canary-apac; 2) Improve observability so KMS-decrypt denies map into the proxy SLO dashboards and incident alerts.

olivia: Agreed. Quick mitigation — grant temporary role binding and re-run canary?

max: Prefer do a constrained role: allow Decrypt on that specific key for the canary SA only and add audit annotation. I can push that policy in 5 mins.

kevin: Also recommend we add a negative test to the keystore RBAC CI job to prevent future prune from removing the proxy decrypt binding without a rollout plan.

olivia: For the longer term, do we want the proxies to use KMS for session ticket keys or switch to local session ticket encryption with rotation via keystore sync?

sarah: Trade-offs: central KMS gives single source-of-truth but is brittle to RBAC changes. Local encrypt+sync reduces KMS calls at handshake time but requires secure key distribution and rotation. Might be good to pilot local ticket keys for edge proxies in APAC and EU.

max: Proposal:
- short term: restore decrypt for canary SA + re-run canary (max)
- medium: add RBAC negative tests (kevin)
- pilot: local ticket key sync + encryption-at-rest with KMS-wrapped keys (sarah, infra)
- monitoring: surface KMS_DENY metrics into proxy alerting and put a Loki/trace link in the dashboard (olivia)

kevin: I'll own the RBAC CI change. Will add a test that simulates Decrypt and fails PRs that remove required bindings.

olivia: max, want me to hold off re-running canary until your temporary role is live?

max: Yep, will post when applied.

deploy-bot: NOTE: IAM policy change applied for role "proxy-session-decrypt-canary" to principal svc-proxy-canary-apac at 2026-03-22T10:20:12Z by max.

olivia: Re-running canary now. Initial metrics look good — session-resume errors dropped back to baseline after ~120s.

auditor-bot: Link to audit: https://audits.internal/2026-03-22/kms-decrypt/apac?key=proxy-session-ticket

sarah: Action items captured. I'll open a short RFC for the local session-ticket-sync pilot and include threat model + rotation cadence. Kevin to create RBAC CI PR. Olivia to add KMS_DENY alert to proxy dashboards. Max to shepherd the temporary policy rollback once pilot lands.

olivia: Thanks all. Filing incident follow-up notes in runbook. :white_check_mark:

kevin: TL;DR for postmortem — unintended RBAC prune caused KMS decrypt denies -> session ticket decrypt failures -> visible resume failures in APAC proxy canary; mitigated by temporary role + plan for longer-term local ticket key pilot.

olivia: I'll drop the runbook link here once created.

olivia: runbook: https://runbooks.internal/edge/ticket-key-kms-rbac-incident-2026-03-22
